responsibility: Declares the MacroBuiltin interface that maps Rust standard-library builtin macro names to compiler expansion handlers. It serves as the public header for builtin transcriber entry points, with one static handler per supported builtin macro, each returning an AST::Fragment from an AST::MacroInvocData invocation so the macro expander can dispatch compiler-implemented macros separately from declarative macro_rules! expansion.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of builtin-macro support: it names the MacroBuiltin class and the static handler API used by the expander to dispatch compiler-implemented macros. The corresponding .cc file contains the real argument parsing, validation, filesystem/environment interaction, and fragment construction for each builtin.
